Elektronik ve yazılımı, bir fikri çalışa: I see electronics and software as two complementary parts of turning an idea into a working system. In my ESP32 and Arduino projects, I focus on reading sensor data, communicating with hardware and creating clear user interfaces.
Çalışmalarımda devre bağlantılarından mi: My work brings together the different layers of a system, from circuit connections and microcontroller code to serial communication and web interfaces. Through projects such as Spotify Dot Matrix and Servo Radar, I build applications that make data visible and interactive.
Geliştirme yaklaşımım; küçük bir prototi: My approach starts with a small prototype, validates connections and code step by step, and documents the result clearly. By sharing wiring diagrams, materials lists and source code, I aim to make my projects easy to examine and reproduce.
Bu portfolyo, tamamlanan projelerimin ya: This portfolio records both my completed projects and my ongoing learning and development. I explore new ideas in electronics, embedded systems and web technologies, and welcome technical questions and opportunities to build together.

Gerilim bölücü bir regülatör değildir. Y: A voltage divider is not a regulator. Its output voltage changes with the load; do not use it as a power supply.
Tek bir seri LED kolu için gereken diren: Find the resistor needed for one series LED string. The next higher standard E24 value is also suggested to keep current at or below the target.
Önerilen güç sınıfı, hesaplanan direnç k: The suggested power rating is at least twice the calculated resistor dissipation. Calculations use nominal values; check actual Vf, tolerance and temperature. Each parallel LED string needs its own resistor.
Pil ve cihaz farklı gerilimlerde çalışsa: Estimate runtime from energy, even when the battery and device use different voltages. Use average consumption and converter efficiency.
Kesme gerilimi ve kapasite kaybı için ay: Allowance for cutoff voltage and capacity loss.
Doğrudan, aynı gerilimde besleme için %1: Use 100% when powering the device directly at the same voltage.
Bu süre bir tahmindir. Pil kimyası, sıca: This runtime is an estimate. Battery chemistry, temperature, aging, current spikes, converter idle consumption and self-discharge can affect the result. In the formula, k and η range from 0 to 1.
